name: RWKV-6 (Finch) 7B

release_date.note: creation of the HF-format repo RWKV/v6-Finch-7B-HF; the original checkpoint may be older. The RWKV-6 paper (2024-04-08) covers only Finch 1.6B and 3B

params.note: derived from config and remote code; equals the Hub's safetensors count

tokenizer.note: RWKV World tokenizer: greedy longest match over a fixed vocabulary (rwkv_vocab_v20230424.txt)

mixers.note: Finch time-mix: 64 heads of 64, matrix-valued state per head, data-dependent decay

stack.note: time-mix then channel-mix in every block

steps.label: ln1 (layer 0 also applies pre_ln to the embeddings first)
time-mix: token shift with data-dependent lerp (LoRA), r/k/v/g projections, WKV recurrence with LoRA decay and bonus u, per-head GroupNorm, SiLU gate, output
channel-mix: token shift, key 4096 -> 14336, squared ReLU, value 14336 -> 4096, times sigmoid(receptance)

specials.name: token_shift
specials.what: each sublayer mixes the current token with the previous one; in time-mix the mix weights depend on the input through a small LoRA (ddlerp), in channel-mix they are fixed per channel

specials.name: data_dependent_decay
specials.what: the per-channel decay of the WKV state is computed from the input through a LoRA (rank 128 at 7B)

code.note: remote code: Rwkv6Block (pre_ln on layer 0, ln1, attention, add, ln2, feed_forward, add); TIME_MIX_EXTRA_DIM 64 and TIME_DECAY_EXTRA_DIM 128 for hidden 4096; FFN width int(3.5d//32*32)

paper.title: Eagle and Finch: RWKV with Matrix-Valued States and Dynamic Recurrence
paper.note: sections 4-5: Finch token shift, ddlerp, World tokenizer

readme.note: 'HF compatible model for Finch-7B'; license apache-2.0

count.note: 2Vd (untied head) + L*(time-mix 5d^2 + LoRAs + small vectors + GroupNorm, channel-mix 2*d*3.5d + d^2, 2 LayerNorms) + pre_ln + ln_out

figure_links.author: RWKV (Peng et al.)
figure_links.title: Figure 1 of the paper: the Eagle and Finch time-mix and channel-mix blocks

unknowns.context_length.value: recurrent model: no position limit in config; Finch 7B training length not stated in the fetched sources
unknowns.tokenizer.kind: the World tokenizer is a trie with greedy matching, not one of the glossary kinds
unknowns.ffn.config_activation: config sets intermediate_size null and no activation; code hard-codes squared ReLU

notes: Remote code lists head.weight as tied, but config tie_word_embeddings is false and the Hub count only matches with a separate head; record treats them as untied.
heads and head_dim describe the WKV state: 64 heads of 64 channels, each with a 64x64 state matrix.
ffn.activation relu2: channel-mix squares the ReLU of its key and multiplies the result by sigmoid(receptance).
